title: Funko Pop! Star Wars The Acolyte Osha Aniseya #722 Bobblehead Vinyl Figure
conditionDescription: Figure is clean with no paint flaws. Box has been opened (one photo shows the figure out in its insert) and has shelf wear: corner wear, a scuff at the top of the side panel, a small tear along one edge of the top panel, and a store price sticker on the bottom. See photos.
descriptionText:
Funko Pop! Star Wars #722 Osha Aniseya from The Acolyte. Bobblehead vinyl figure, about 4 in. tall, in the original window box with plastic insert.

Figure is clean with no paint flaws; the box has been opened. Box shows shelf wear and has a store price sticker on the bottom - see photos. Two available; the photos show one of the actual boxes.

Ships boxed and padded to protect the window box.
